acceptance: When a failed suite's merge commit predates current develop, make pr-rerun starts CI on a fresh merge ref and pr-arm accepts a head whose newest suite passed without deleting runs; a unit test covers the stale merge case.
description: After trunk was fixed by #3908, #3907 and #3827 still carried a failed 'core' suite from a CI run that tested their heads merged with the broken develop (abc110263). make pr-rerun re-ran that run's failed jobs, but GitHub re-runs reuse the original merge SHA, so the same tests failed again. Closing and reopening each PR produced a fresh run that passed, yet pr-arm then refused because the old failed suite is 'hidden behind a newer success' and still counts in the merge rollup, and its advice was again make pr-rerun. The only way through was deleting the stale failed runs (41273807700, 41273329730) with gh run delete. pr-rerun should detect that the failed run's merge base predates a trunk fix and start a fresh run (or tell the user to close and reopen), and pr-arm's hidden-failure advice should not loop back to pr-rerun.
